```{r}
# load needed packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(baseballr) 
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

```

```{r}
# get park data
ballparks_stadium_data <- read_csv("../../data/ballparks_stadium_data_2022.csv")
head(ballparks_stadium_data)
```

```{r}
# get downloaded hitter stats
`2022HitterStats` <- read_csv("../../data/2022HitterStats.csv")
head(`2022HitterStats`)
```

```{r}
# get player team info
Player_team_info <- mlb_stats(stat_type = 'season', stat_group = 'hitting', season = 2022) |>
  select(player_id, team_name, league_name)
```


```{r}
# join hitter stats with players team
Full_22_Hitter_stats <- `2022HitterStats` |>
  left_join(Player_team_info, join_by(player_id))

head(Full_22_Hitter_stats)
```

```{r}
# join park stats and hitting stats
player_and_park_stats <- Full_22_Hitter_stats |>
  left_join(ballparks_stadium_data) 
```

```{r}
# Some graphs that we could use (These need effective viz like alt caps, also feel free to do other effective viz aspects like coloring for improvement!)

#Density graph of On base % by different teams
ggplot(Full_22_Hitter_stats, aes(x = on_base_percent, y = team_name, fill = team_name)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 2, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "On Base %",
       y = "Team",
       title = "Distribution of OBP by Home Park (Ridgeline)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}

# Expected vs Observed slugging percentage by teams in national league west
ggplot(National_League_West_22, aes(x = xslg, y = slg_percent, color = team_name)) +
  geom_point()  +
    geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Expected SLG", y = "Observed SLG", color = "Team Name",
       title = "Observed vs. Expected SLG by Hitter (colored by Park) in National League West teams") +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
# Actual vs Expected Batting Average
ggplot(df, aes(x = xba, y = batting_avg, color = league_name)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs. Expected Batting Average",
    x = "Expected BA (xba)",
    y = "Observed BA (batting_avg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Actual vs Expected Slugging
ggplot(df, aes(x = xslg, y = slg_percent, color = league_name)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs. Expected Slugging %",
    x = "Expected SLG (xslg)",
    y = "Observed SLG (slg_percent)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Park Effects vs. Hard-Hit % 
ggplot(df, aes(x = hr_park_effects, y = hard_hit_percent, color = ballpark)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "HR Park Effects vs. Hard-Hit %",
    x = "HR Park Effects (100 = avg)",
    y = "Hard-Hit %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
#Extra Distance → Home Runs
ggplot(df, aes(x = extra_distance, y = home_run, color = ballpark)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Extra Distance vs. Home Runs",
    x = "Extra Distance (yards)",
    y = "Home Runs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Field Dimensions: Left vs. Right (size = park factor)
ggplot(df, aes(x = left_field, y = right_field, size = hr_park_effects)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Left‐Field vs. Right‐Field Distance\n(point size ∝ HR Park Effects)",
    x = "Left Field Distance (yd)",
    y = "Right Field Distance (yd)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Roof Cover vs. Day Games
ggplot(df, aes(x = roof, y = daytime)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Pct. Roofed Games vs. Pct. Daytime Games",
    x = "Roof Cover (%)",
    y = "Daytime Games (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# difference in expected vs actual weighted on base avreage compared to park effects
ggplot(player_and_park_stats, aes(x = hr_park_effects, y = wobadiff)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# difference in expected vs actual slugging compared to park effects
ggplot(player_and_park_stats, aes(x = hr_park_effects, y = xslgdiff)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Vis of teams with over six batters on the dataset
player_and_park_stats |>
  filter(team_name %in%c("Baltimore Orioles", "Houston Astros", "Los Angeles Dodgers", "New York Mets", "New York Yankees", "Seattle Mariners", "Toronto Blue Jays", "San Diego Padres")) |>
ggplot(aes(x = woba, y = xwoba, color = team_name, size = hr_park_effects)) +
  geom_point()
```
